propositions: The reconciler core currently reaches directly into Jira adapter modules with no named backend interface, blocking a second vendor implementation.

A Backend facade with five role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention) and three @runtime_checkable capability Protocols must be defined to abstract vendor-specific behavior.
JiraBackend must wrap existing Jira modules as a pure delegation shim with zero behavior change, serving as the first Backend implementation.
The IdentityConvention pure convention object must format RemoteRef to rebar-id label strings and parse them back, centralizing the label format currently inlined across four core call sites.

A backend-agnostic contract suite parameterized over both JiraBackend (with injected mock transport) and FakeBackend must verify outbound-to-inbound round-trips, sanitizer idempotence, capability dispatch via isinstance, and pure mapper characterization.
